what: First build of pins-planning-appeal-outcome per the recorded handoff (novelty differentiated 2026-10-31, all five contracts supported). Construct -> full-artifact qualification (gate 1.5.0) -> exact-byte acceptance -> simple references, in that enforced order; no performance metric before acceptance. Frame: s78_core casework types with binary Decision in {Allowed, Dismissed}, both GOV.UK Excel files re-downloaded by exact recorded URL and sha256-pinned to the discovery bytes (a re-issued publication fails the build); cross-file dedup on the publisher-documented date composite; decided-before-validated rows excluded and counted. Splits keyed on the VALIDATION instant (the shipped time column valid_date): train < 2020-01-01, eval 2020-2021, holdout >= 2022-01-01 - the provisional decision-year partition moved to the instant because the outcome date cannot ship (post-instant) and the gate requires disjoint split ranges on a shipped time column; per-decision-year counts still reproduce the discovery probe exactly (in-build fixture, 11 years, first verified in a bounded local smoke build on the pinned bytes). Local smoke build of the same pinned bytes: 139,264 eligible rows, train 54,834/17,048 (31.1%), eval 28,104/8,469 (30.1%), holdout 56,326/17,705 (31.4%), byte-identical on rebuild, gate 1.5.0 locally 45/45 after the -1 sentinel fix for lpa_allow_rate_prior. LPA-history features computed strictly from decision dates earlier than each row's Valid Date (brute-force sample asserted); cross-row exposure declared via the gate's probe mechanism (lpa_last_outcome over the previous same-LPA case) with isolated_rows access and no enforcement claim. Dropped with measured reasons: enforcement_grounds_count (0 populated in the eligible population), publisher site flags below the 100-value presence threshold, LPA Decision Date / LPA Application Reference (not carried by the older file), Costs Applied for Indicator (post-instant), Lead Case (joinable cross-row id), PII columns. Expected artifact ~36 MB CSVs. Stopping condition: any failed stage exits non-zero and leaves its report for collection; the smoke build's green gate makes a failure here a worker-environment or drift problem to diagnose, not a silent retry.
